preconditions: Owned native Linux transaction and independently checked publication model, plan and complete file inventories.
Explicit transaction-bound host authority; real stopped Linux processes and native root mutex for orphan recovery; independent normative byte oracle.
steps: Interrupt a real publication and observe the complete current normative membership and exact bytes.
Complete the bound full target or restore the bound basis; preserve foreign files and all recovery evidence.
Reject additional, missing, changed and concurrently observed resources; compare mutation and read-only diagnosis.
Resume proved terminal completion after lost synchronization or archive responses without another normative write; retain pending and foreign blockers until full cleanup proof.
Recover an abruptly stopped writer through the native mutex and explicit transaction-bound authority; preserve the ordinary lock-recover journal veto.

Fail the first recovery receipt after creation, a partial write and a complete write with lost fsync response; assert truthful mutation diagnostics, retained bytes and unchanged normative target. Reject an existing conflicting receipt without mutation.

oracle.requirement_contract: Wenn alle Nachher-Hashes einer unterbrochenen Transaktion vorhanden sind und dem Journal entsprechen, MUSS Recovery fehlende Audit- und Request-Receipts aus dem Journal rekonstruieren und die Transaktion anschließend als `committed` abschließen, statt den vollständig veröffentlichten Zustand zurückzurollen.
oracle.scope: Complete supported resource membership and exact byte equality bind the independently prepared basis/target roots through the checked journal. Complete-target recovery adds immutable action evidence; terminal cleanup and explicit audited orphan takeover retain exact target bytes across real process stops and lost durability responses. No automatic recovery or full fault-injection acceptance is claimed. First-receipt creation/write/synchronization failures report possible operational mutation without claiming a normative write or completion.

open_items: Extended directory and later-marker mutation accounting boundaries and structural consolidation remain AUDIT-REC-03.R/C.

Short auxiliary recovery writes remain blocked and preserved; their restart investigation remains AUDIT-REC-04. Automatic preflight, full fault injection and restore stay in their original later plan positions.
